title: Criiing! Kamu dapet GoPay Coins 💰
text: Cihuy, kamu dapet 26 GoPay Coins! Klik buat liat detailnya.
notes: The negative fixture that matters most: it arrived 88ms before a real receipt, on the same channel, from the same package.
'26 GoPay Coins' is a bare number with a currency-shaped word next to it. Anything that treats a number as an amount without a Rp/IDR marker will book 26 rupiah of income that never existed.
Coins are not money in this ledger and never become a transaction.
